modes.center: Each member separately placed at rounded source slim-box center + grid offset; records actual internal anchor and template origin.
modes.anchor: Both members use the filled member source-center-derived internal anchor; records actual slim-box center and origin.

comparators: Same binary with forced probe off/on; fixed v3 candidate recognition settings. Both must match frozen V3 candidate written events. Diagnostic ignores scanner vetoes and does not propose heads.
limitations: Fixed annotated positive centers; not unbiased final precision.
Open-square controls use native BLACK/VOID pair; these are not shape-specific square templates.
No mask causality claim from scanner minima; forced observations do not independently certify source accuracy.
